name: fastseo-site
description: Build and quality checks for fastseo.site

scripts.build: npm run fix:images && npm run generate:sitemap && npm run generate:feed && npm run audit:routing && node scripts/build-site.mjs
scripts.check:js: node --check assets/js/webmcp.js && node --check assets/js/site.js && node --check assets/js/home.js && node --check assets/js/tools-catalog.js
scripts.audit: npm run check:js && npm run audit:seo && npm run audit:headings && npm run audit:external-links && npm run audit:links && npm run audit:security && npm run audit:catalog && npm run audit:translations && npm run audit:routing && npm run audit:performance
scripts.audit:ci: npm run check:js && npm run audit:seo && npm run audit:headings && npm run audit:links && npm run audit:security && npm run audit:catalog && npm run audit:routing && npm run audit:performance
